integrity: Necessity follows from the permanent obstruction created by two unobserved leaves at an unselected center. Sufficiency follows because each unselected center then has at most one unobserved leaf after the domination step. The exact side characterization makes the generating function multiplicative, and a separate exhaustive simulator verifies every subset for thirty-six parameter pairs.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to proper double stars with both leaf multiplicities at least two.
Finite exhaustive verification covers leaf multiplicities from two through seven and is corroborative only.
The factor polynomials for individual stars are prior work; the new claim is the connected bridge characterization and resulting factorization.
Search coverage cannot exclude an unindexed or differently phrased bistar enumeration.
title: Bridge factorization of power domination polynomials for proper double stars
